item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0012-E014","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0012-E015","status":"rejected","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt concerns recommendations on investigating torture complaints and the death penalty; it does not report deaths in detention, health-care-related deaths, or missing death-investigation data."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0012-E016","status":"rejected","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt does not contain the proposed claim about routine torture to obtain confessions, use of coerced confessions in court, or courts generally failing to investigate complaints."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0012-E017","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0012-E018","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0012-E019","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The Committee reported that persons accused of habitual debauchery under Egypt’s prostitution law were sometimes subjected to forced anal examinations, and that vaginal examinations were sometimes conducted without consent to prove sexual acts.","notes":["Narrowed “accused under prostitution law” to the excerpt’s specific reference to persons accused of habitual debauchery under the prostitution law."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0012-E020","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
